summary: Tested logging games played anywhere vs at an IRL meetup. Backend: 12 of 12 pytest checks pass. POST /api/logs defaults at_meetup to false and accepts dates up to 360 days back with no check-in. at_meetup=true without a check-in returns 400; with a check-in it returns 200. Dates more than 365 days back or in the future return 400, and a non-boolean at_meetup returns 422. GET /api/me/checkin-dates returns distinct sorted dates, leaves out a 400-day-old check-in and returns 401 when logged out. Raffle bonus for past block Sep-Oct 2026 (check-ins on 09-05 and 10-10): with only anywhere logs, or a meetup log on just one date, no bonus is given. Once both dates have meetup logs, one bonus is awarded (2026 period 4, 3 entries, 3 raffle numbers from 'bonus'). Reminders and dashboard unlogged_dates/bonus.current.missing_dates still list a check-in date that only has an anywhere log, and drop it after a meetup log is added. The admin session summary shows only meetup logs. Leaderboards and monthly stats include both kinds of log. UI (desktop and 390px mobile): with no check-in the switch is disabled and the hint says 'played anywhere'. On a check-in date the switch is enabled and ON by default. Turning it off saves as anywhere. The table shows MEETUP/ANYWHERE badges (gamelog-where-<id>). The reminder banner shows and then disappears after a meetup log. The honour note, banner, bonus card and landing text describe the rule. FOUND 1 BUG: the switch default is lost on the second log for the same check-in date.

ui_bugs.issue: Repro: the user is checked in today (the common case at a meetup) and logs two games in a row with the default date. The first log saves at_meetup=true. On the second open the switch is enabled but OFF, so the log saves at_meetup=false without warning (confirmed in the DB), which can cost the user the raffle bonus. RCA: after saving, setF({...blank}) clears at_meetup because blank has no at_meetup key. The useEffect that sets at_meetup only runs when canMeetup changes, and canMeetup stays true. Fix: reset at_meetup when the dialog opens or when played_at changes (e.g. useEffect on [canMeetup, open, f.played_at]). Alternatively, keep at_meetup: canMeetup in the reset, or derive the default with ?? (checked = canMeetup && (f.at_meetup ?? true)).

issues: When the user turns the switch OFF on a check-in date, the hint still reads 'Meetup results count toward the 2-month raffle bonus'. Change the text to say this game won't count toward the bonus.
Your player ID is empty for users with no player_tag (minor, existing behaviour).

action_items: Fix the LogGameDialog at_meetup default being lost after a save when the date's check-in status does not change (see RCA)
Optional: change the switch hint when the user turns it OFF on a check-in date
critical_code_review_comments: There is no migration for game_logs created before this change. Any older log without at_meetup is now treated as an anywhere log, so existing users get reminders and lose bonus progress for meetups they did log. The DB currently has 0 logs, so nothing is affected here. If production has older logs, run a one-off update_many to set at_meetup=true where a check-in exists for user_id+played_at, and false otherwise.
Deleting a check-in does not change the at_meetup flag on existing logs. This is acceptable, but period_progress only counts check-in dates, so it stays consistent.
